params:
  rds_path: ""          # path to the serialised model RDS
  model_label: ""       # human-readable label shown in subtitle
  utils_path: ""        # path to ZooBiomassAus_0_Utils.R
  func_path: ""         # path to func/fPlotBiomassLMERs.R
  covariates: NULL      # named list or NULL
  interactions: NULL    # list of 2-element vectors or NULL
  random_effects: NULL  # character vector of grouping vars, NULL = auto-detect, character(0) = none
  re_form_na: true      # TRUE = NA (marginalise), FALSE = NULL (BLUPs)
  response_scale: false
  show_rug: true
  show_partial_residuals: false
  ncol: NULL
  ci_method: NULL
  has_comparison: false # TRUE when compare_models list was supplied via the RDS bundle
  n_simulations: 100    # passed to check_model(); lower = faster PPC
  check_model_checks: NULL # NULL = all panels; character vector to restrict panels
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(withr)
library(parameters)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(glmmTMB)
library(splines) # ns() used in model formulae
library(utils4mme) # harmonic() / fHarmonic() used in model formulae
library(marginaleffects)
library(insight)

source(params$utils_path)
source(params$func_path)

# Load model + data bundle saved by fModelDiagnosticsHTML()
bundle <- readRDS(params$rds_path)
model <- bundle$model
compare_models <- bundle$compare_models # NULL when not supplied

# Restore the original data to the global environment so that
# marginaleffects::predictions() can find it by name when building newdata grids.
#
# Model class dispatch for $call$data:
#   - merMod (lmerMod / glmerMod) → S4 slot: model@call$data
#   - glmmTMB / lm / glm          → S3 element: model$call$data
if (!is.null(bundle$data)) {
  data_name <- if (is(model, "merMod")) {
    as.character(model@call$data)
  } else {
    as.character(model$call$data)
  }
  assign(data_name, bundle$data, envir = globalenv())
}

re.form <- if (isTRUE(params$re_form_na)) NA else NULL
```

## Model Formula

```{r formula, results='asis'}
# ── Model function & estimation method ────────────────────────────────────────
is_merMod <- is(model, "merMod")
is_glmerMod <- is(model, "glmerMod")
is_lmerMod <- is(model, "lmerMod")
is_glmmTMB <- is(model, "glmmTMB")
is_glm_base <- is(model, "glm") && !is_merMod
is_lm_base <- is(model, "lm") && !is_merMod && !is_glm_base

if (is_glmmTMB) {
  fn_name <- "glmmTMB"
} else if (is_glmerMod) {
  fn_name <- "glmer"
} else if (is_lmerMod) {
  fn_name <- "lmer"
} else if (is_glm_base) {
  fn_name <- "glm"
} else if (is_lm_base) {
  fn_name <- "lm"
} else {
  fn_name <- class(model)[1]
}

# ── REML / ML for (g)lmer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# glmmTMB uses ML by default; isREML() is not defined for it.
if (is_merMod) {
  reml_used <- tryCatch(isREML(model), error = function(e) NA)
  est_method <- if (isTRUE(reml_used)) {
    "REML"
  } else if (isFALSE(reml_used)) {
    "ML"
  } else {
    "unknown"
  }
} else if (is_glmmTMB) {
  est_method <- "ML"
} else {
  est_method <- NULL
}

# ── Family / error structure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fam_obj <- tryCatch(family(model), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(fam_obj)) {
  fam_str <- paste0(fam_obj$family, "(link = \"", fam_obj$link, "\")")
} else {
  fam_str <- NULL
}

# ── Formula (pretty-printed) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
formula_lines <- deparse(stats::formula(model), width.cutoff = 60)
formula_str <- paste(formula_lines, collapse = "\n")

# ── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("**Fitting function:** `", fn_name, "`\n\n", sep = "")

if (!is.null(fam_str)) {
  cat("**Error structure / family:** `", fam_str, "`\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat(
    "**Error structure:** Gaussian (identity link) — log\u2081\u2080-transformed response\n\n"
  )
}

if (!is.null(est_method)) {
  cat("**Estimation method:** ", est_method, "\n\n", sep = "")
}

cat("**Formula:**\n\n```\n", formula_str, "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

if (!is.null(params$ci_method)) {

}

withr::with_options(

## 2 · Model Diagnostics

*Posterior predictive check, linearity, homogeneity of variance, influential observations, normality of residuals, normality of random effects.*

```{r ppc-note, results='asis'}
# Issue 6 fix: add a note explaining the log10 x-axis on the PPC for log-link
# models.  Without this, the rescaled PPC can look unfamiliar to readers who
# expect the default linear-scale density plot.
.fam_note <- tryCatch(family(model), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(.fam_note) && .fam_note$link == "log") {
  cat(
    "> **Note on the Posterior Predictive Check:** The x-axis is on a",
    " **log\u2081\u2080 scale** because the response (Biomass) spans several",
    " orders of magnitude. The simulated density lines (light) should closely",
    " track the observed line (dark) — if they do, the model captures the",
    " distribution of the data well.\n\n"
  )
}
```

```{r diagnostics, fig.height=10}
# Build check_model() call args — only add `check` when the caller restricted panels.
# n_simulations controls PPC simulation count (default 100; package default is 250).
.cm_args <- list(model, verbose = FALSE, n_simulations = params$n_simulations)
if (!is.null(params$check_model_checks)) {
  .cm_args$check <- params$check_model_checks
}
cm_obj <- do.call(check_model, .cm_args)
pdf(nullfile())
cm_raw <- plot(cm_obj)
dev.off()

# For models with a log link (e.g. Gamma(link = "log")), the PPC is plotted on
# the raw response scale, which is extremely right-skewed and looks like a
# right angle.  Apply scale_x_log10() to the PPC panel (first element of the
# patchwork) so the density curves are readable.
.fam_check <- tryCatch(family(model), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(.fam_check) && .fam_check$link == "log") {
  cm_raw[[1]] <- cm_raw[[1]] + scale_x_log10()
}

# Apply shared theme to all panels
cm_themed <- cm_raw &
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Stagger x-axis labels on the collinearity (VIF) panel so they are readable.
# The VIF panel title contains "Collinearity"; find it by inspecting panel labels.
vif_idx <- which(vapply(
  seq_along(cm_themed),
  function(i) {
    ttl <- cm_themed[[i]]$labels$title
    isTRUE(grepl("ollinearity|VIF", ttl, ignore.case = TRUE))
  },
  logical(1)
))

if (length(vif_idx) == 1L) {
  # Build a lookup from raw term labels → clean variable names using the same
  # AST-walking approach as .raw_var() in fPlotBiomassLMERs.R.
  # insight::find_predictors() returns the bare variable names; we match them
  # against the term labels that appear on the VIF x-axis.
  .raw_var_from_term <- function(term_str) {
    term_str <- trimws(term_str)
    if (grepl("(", term_str, fixed = TRUE)) {
      expr <- tryCatch(str2lang(term_str), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(expr)) {
        .first_sym <- function(node) {
          if (is.symbol(node)) {
            return(as.character(node))
          }
          if (is.call(node)) {
            for (i in seq(2L, length(node))) {
              hit <- .first_sym(node[[i]])
              if (!is.null(hit)) return(hit)
            }
          }
          NULL
        }
        hit <- .first_sym(expr)
        if (!is.null(hit)) return(hit)
      }
    }
    term_str
  }

  vif_panel <- cm_themed[[vif_idx]]
  vif_built <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(vif_panel)
  x_labels <- vif_built$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x$get_labels()
  x_breaks <- vif_built$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x$get_breaks()
  clean_labels <- vapply(x_labels, .raw_var_from_term, character(1))

  cm_themed[[vif_idx]] <- vif_panel +
    scale_x_discrete(
      breaks = x_breaks,
      labels = clean_labels,
      guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)
    )
}

cm_themed
```

## 3 · Covariate Effects

*Marginal predictions (fixed effects, random effects marginalised out) with 95 % confidence intervals. Random-effect grouping variables are shown as caterpillar plots of BLUPs (conditional modes ± 1.96 SE).*

```{r covariate-effects, fig.height=8}
# params$random_effects arrives as NULL (auto-detect) or a character vector.
# Quarto serialises character(0) as NULL, so we treat NULL as auto-detect here
# and let fPlotBiomassLMERs() call .extract_random_grouping_vars() internally.
fPlotBiomassLMERs(
  model = model,
  covariates = params$covariates,
  interactions = params$interactions,
  random_effects = params$random_effects,
  re.form = re.form,
  response_scale = params$response_scale,
  show_rug = params$show_rug,
  show_partial_residuals = params$show_partial_residuals,
  ncol = params$ncol
)
```

```{r model-comparison-section, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(params$has_comparison) && !is.null(compare_models)) {
  cat("## 4 · Model Comparison\n\n")
  cat(
    "*Ranked performance indices across all compared models.",
    " Higher rank = better overall fit.*\n\n"
  )
}
```

```{r model-comparison-table, eval=isTRUE(params$has_comparison) && !is.null(compare_models)}
# compare_performance() uses match.call() internally to derive model labels.
# do.call() does not preserve symbol names in that call frame, so we instead
# assign each model to a named variable in a temporary environment and build
# the call using as.symbol() so compare_performance() sees the real names.
cmp_names <- names(compare_models) # e.g. c("m4", "m5", "m6", "m7", "m8")

# Assign models into a local env whose parent is globalenv() so that
# compare_performance() and all package functions remain on the search path.
cmp_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
for (.nm in cmp_names) {
  assign(.nm, compare_models[[.nm]], envir = cmp_env)
}

# Build and evaluate: compare_performance(m4, m5, …, rank = TRUE)
cmp_call_ranked <- as.call(c(
  list(quote(compare_performance)),
  lapply(cmp_names, as.symbol),
  list(rank = TRUE)
))
eval(cmp_call_ranked, envir = cmp_env)
```

```{r model-comparison-plot, eval=isTRUE(params$has_comparison) && !is.null(compare_models), fig.height=7}
# Build the same call without rank = TRUE for the radar plot
cmp_call_plot <- as.call(c(
  list(quote(compare_performance)),
  lapply(cmp_names, as.symbol)
))
plot(eval(cmp_call_plot, envir = cmp_env))
```
